name: Personal Branding Playful
tagline: An 18-page personal-brand system with original Savate headlines, licensed Unbounded caps, Poppins body copy and independent native vector stickers.

palette.description: Source cream and black canvases with high-saturation pink, green, blue, red and yellow vector stickers; measured source fills are retained individually.

best_for: Creative freelancers, multidisciplinary professionals and founders introducing their point of view, distinctive strengths, services, client proof and collaboration ideas.
avoid_for: High-formality board reporting, dense numerical reviews or restrained corporate material. Large sticker frames and expressive type should remain part of the composition.

typography.style: Savate Regular (original static 2015 MIT font) and Poppins 500/600 (original 4.004 OFL) remain unchanged. Hanson Bold is replaced by OFL Unbounded700 variable TTF1.701 because complete source font redistribution terms were unavailable. CSS size-adjust 103.329022% and source-baseline font-metric calibration retain the wide-caps voice and source text frames; glyph outlines differ. The original1920×1080 grid, rotations, colors and geometry are preserved. The page 18 contact label reads MAIL to retain the same narrow single-line frame with Unbounded; source CSS sizes and line heights remain.

source_inspiration.name: Meg Lewis — Personal Branding Pitch Deck (Pitch), 18 public slides
source_inspiration.notes: Complete 18-page native HTML/CSS/SVG source-inspired reconstruction. Original1920×1080 frame geometry, palette, independent image crops and page order are preserved; long demo copy is original fictional content. Typography is explicitly adapted: Savate Regular (original static 2015 MIT font) and Poppins 500/600 (original 4.004 OFL) remain unchanged. Hanson Bold is replaced by OFL Unbounded700 variable TTF1.701 because complete source font redistribution terms were unavailable. CSS size-adjust 103.329022% and source-baseline font-metric calibration retain the wide-caps voice and source text frames; glyph outlines differ. The original1920×1080 grid, rotations, colors and geometry are preserved. Source SVG ornaments remain independent native elements; no full-slide screenshot or source platform runtime is used. Source artwork and media retain original rights; font substitution does not establish their separate standalone template distribution clearance. The page 18 contact label reads MAIL to retain the same narrow single-line frame with Unbounded; source CSS sizes and line heights remain.
